items.title: The Optimal Exercise Modality and Dose for Blood Pressure Management in Middle-Aged and Older Adults: A Systematic Review with Bayesian Model-Based, and Dose-Response Network Meta-Analysis of RCTs.
items.summary: This systematic review and Bayesian network meta-analysis of RCTs identified optimal exercise modalities and doses for lowering resting systolic and diastolic BP in middle-aged and older adults (≥45 years) by May 2025.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述通过贝叶斯网络荟萃分析，清晰地比较了不同运动模式和剂量对中老年高血压的降压效果。它能让你更精准地为中老年患者推荐运动处方，尤其是针对最佳降压效果的运动类型和强度。
items.titleZh: 中老年高血压患者血压管理的最优运动模式和剂量：一项基于贝叶斯模型和剂量反应网络荟萃分析的 RCT 系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项对随机对照试验进行的系统综述和贝叶斯网络荟萃分析，识别了截至 2025 年 5 月中老年（≥45 岁）高血压患者降低静息收缩压和舒张压的最优运动模式和剂量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and Bayesian network meta-analysis clearly compare the blood pressure-lowering effects of different exercise modalities and doses in middle-aged and older adults. This means you can more precisely recommend exercise prescriptions for patients ≥45 years old, especially regarding the optimal exercise type and intensity for blood pressure reduction, avoiding a 'one-size-fits-all' approach.
items.limitation: 剂量-反应分析的细节和异质性来源未在摘要中详细说明。
items.limitationEn: Details of the dose-response analysis and sources of heterogeneity were not elaborated in the abstract.

items.title: Prestroke Rehabilitation Reserve and Mobility and Self-Care Outcomes After Incident Stroke Across Four International Aging Cohorts.
items.summary: A harmonized longitudinal cohort study (N=7486, mean age 70.0 years) across four international aging cohorts found that lower multidimensional pre-stroke rehabilitation reserve was associated with adverse mobility and self-care status after incident stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项跨国队列研究强调了卒中前康复储备的重要性。它证实了较低的储备与卒中后更差的移动和自理能力相关，提示我们需要更重视早期识别和干预，以增强患者的整体康复潜力。
items.titleZh: 卒中前康复储备与卒中后移动和自理能力结局在四个国际老年队列中的关系
items.summaryZh: 一项在四个国际老年队列中进行的统一纵向队列研究（N=7486，平均年龄 70.0 岁）发现，多维度卒中前康复储备较低与卒中后不利的移动和自理能力状况相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multinational cohort study underscores the importance of pre-stroke rehabilitation reserve. It confirms that lower reserve is associated with poorer mobility and self-care outcomes after stroke, suggesting a need for greater emphasis on early identification and intervention to enhance overall rehabilitation potential.
items.limitation: 由于是观察性研究，无法建立因果关系，且康复储备的衡量可能受文化和环境因素影响。
items.limitationEn: As an observational study, it cannot establish causality, and the measurement of rehabilitation reserve may be influenced by cultural and environmental factors.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: Prestroke Rehabilitation Reserve and Mobility and Self-Care Outcomes After Incident Stroke Across Four International Aging Cohorts

items.title: Responsiveness, Smallest Detectable Change, and Minimal Important Change of the Turkish Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-20 Following Pelvic Floor Muscle Training.
items.summary: This multicenter, retrospective study (N=200 women) determined the responsiveness, smallest detectable change (SDC), and minimal important change (MIC) of the Turkish Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-20 (PFDI-20) following an 8-week pelvic floor muscle training intervention.
items.curatedReason: 土耳其语版 PFDI-20 量表的响应度、SDC 和 MIC 数据现已明确。这意味着你在评估土耳其患者盆底肌训练效果时，能更精确地判断临床上有意义的变化，避免过度解读微小波动。
items.titleZh: 盆底肌训练后土耳其语版盆底困扰量表-20 (PFDI-20) 的响应度、最小可检测变化和最小重要变化
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心回顾性研究（N=200 名女性）评估了土耳其语版盆底困扰量表-20 (PFDI-20) 在经过 8 周盆底肌训练后的响应度、最小可检测变化 (SDC) 和最小重要变化 (MIC)。
items.curatedReasonEn: The responsiveness, SDC, and MIC data for the Turkish PFDI-20 scale are now clear. This means you can more accurately determine clinically meaningful changes when assessing the effectiveness of pelvic floor muscle training in Turkish-speaking patients, avoiding over-interpretation of minor fluctuations.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性设计，可能存在选择偏倚和数据完整性问题。
items.limitationEn: This study used a retrospective design, which may be subject to selection bias and data completeness issues.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Relief increases select shoulder muscle activity, following subacromial injection in subacromial pain syndrome.
items.summary: This study (N=21) found that subacromial injection, which reduced pain, immediately increased activity in select shoulder muscles during humeral elevation in individuals with subacromial pain syndrome.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，亚肩峰注射缓解疼痛后，患者特定肩部肌肉的激活模式会立即改变，这提示疼痛管理在优化肩部神经肌肉功能中扮演了重要角色。
items.titleZh: 亚肩峰疼痛综合征患者亚肩峰注射缓解疼痛后，特定肩部肌肉活动度增加
items.summaryZh: 这项研究（N=21）发现，亚肩峰疼痛综合征患者在亚肩峰注射缓解疼痛后，其肱骨抬高过程中特定肩部肌肉的活动度立即增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that pain relief following subacromial injection immediately alters activation patterns of select shoulder muscles, suggesting that pain management plays a crucial role in optimizing shoulder neuromuscular function.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小 (N=21)，且存在 EMG 信号变异性问题。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (N=21) and issues with EMG signal variability.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Characteristics of Classified Gait Pattern Subgroups and Definitions of Abnormal Gait Patterns Following Stroke: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: This scoping review comprehensively explored the existing characteristics of classified gait pattern subgroups following stroke, highlighting the uncertainty in current definitions despite the importance of individualized gait training.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后偏瘫步态的分类远未明晰。尽管这项综述未能提供新的定义，但它指出了现有分类框架的局限性，提示我们不能盲目套用现有模式，个体化评估仍是关键。
items.titleZh: 卒中后分类步态模式亚组特征及异常步态模式定义：范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述全面探讨了卒中后分类步态模式亚组的现有特征，强调了尽管个体化步态训练至关重要，但当前定义仍存在不确定性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stroke hemiplegic gait classification remains unclear. While this review doesn't offer new definitions, it highlights the limitations of existing frameworks, suggesting we shouldn't blindly apply current models; individualized assessment remains crucial.
items.limitation: 本综述识别了现有分类方法的异质性和不确定性，但未提供具体的量化数据来指导临床决策。
items.limitationEn: The review identified heterogeneity and uncertainty in existing classification methods but did not provide specific quantitative data to guide clinical decisions.

items.title: On "Early mobilization in patients with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage: a prospective observational study." Hernandez S, Tipping C, Deane AM, et al. Phys Ther. 2026;106(4):pzag031. https://doi.org/10.1093/ptj/pzag031.
items.summary: This article provides a commentary on a prospective observational study regarding early mobilization in patients with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评围绕动脉瘤性蛛网膜下腔出血患者的早期动员展开，提醒我们对观察性研究的解读要谨慎。在缺乏高级别证据时，早期动员仍需权衡风险与益处。
items.titleZh: 关于《动脉瘤性蛛网膜下腔出血患者的早期动员：一项前瞻性观察研究》的评论
items.summaryZh: 本文对一项关于动脉瘤性蛛网膜下腔出血患者早期动员的前瞻性观察研究进行了评论。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary on early mobilization in patients with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage reminds us to interpret observational studies cautiously. In the absence of high-level evidence, early mobilization still requires careful consideration of risks versus benefits.

items.title: Advancing Payment: What the Proposed 2027 Medicare Fee Schedule Means for PTs
items.summary: APTA has released an analysis of the proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule, highlighting key provisions affecting physical therapists' payment and practice, with a call for member comments by Sept. 14.
items.curatedReason: APTA发布了关于2027年Medicare医师收费标准拟议规则的分析，直接关系到你在美国的报销和执业模式。务必利用9月14日前的窗口期，向CMS提交你的反馈意见，影响最终政策制定。
items.titleZh: 推进支付：2027年Medicare收费标准拟议对物理治疗师的意义
items.summaryZh: APTA发布了对2027年Medicare医师收费标准拟议规则的分析，强调了影响物理治疗师支付和执业的关键条款，并呼吁会员在9月14日前提交意见。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA has released an analysis on the proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule, directly impacting your reimbursement and practice model in the U.S. Ensure you submit your feedback to CMS before the September 14 deadline to influence final policy-making.

items.title: Effects of functional versus conventional Physiotherapy-Based pain management on symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 28 women with Bladder Pain Syndrome (BPS) found that a functional physiotherapy program (pain science education, cognition-targeted exercises, relaxation) significantly improved symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life compared to conventional physiotherapy (TENS, manual therapy, strengthening).
items.curatedReason: 功能性物理治疗对膀胱疼痛综合征患者的益处显著，优于传统疗法。尽管样本量只有 28 人，但其生物心理社会整合干预的成功，提示我们应优先考虑疼痛科学教育和认知训练。
items.titleZh: 功能性与传统物理治疗对膀胱疼痛综合征女性患者症状、心理结局及生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验纳入28名膀胱疼痛综合征（BPS）女性患者，结果显示功能性物理治疗（疼痛科学教育、认知导向练习、放松练习）在改善症状、心理结局和生活质量方面优于传统物理治疗（TENS、手法治疗、肌力训练）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Functional physiotherapy significantly outperforms conventional methods for Bladder Pain Syndrome. Although the RCT only included 28 women, its success with a biopsychosocial integrated intervention suggests prioritizing pain science education and cognitive-targeted exercises.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（28名女性），且为单中心研究，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (28 women) and was a single-center study, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Acute effects of squat and core exercises using elastic bands on post-activation performance enhancement in tennis players: control, randomized, crossover trials
items.summary: This randomized, crossover trial investigated the acute effects of squat and core exercises using elastic bands on post-activation performance enhancement (PAPE) in tennis players, finding beneficial outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，对于网球运动员，使用弹力带的深蹲和核心训练可以提高赛后激活表现。这意味着你可以在缺乏重阻力器械时，考虑将弹力带训练作为一种有效的赛前热身或训练方案。
items.titleZh: 弹力带深蹲和核心训练对网球运动员赛后激活表现的急性影响：随机交叉对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机交叉对照试验研究了使用弹力带进行深蹲和核心练习对网球运动员赛后激活表现（PAPE）的急性影响，发现有益结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that squat and core exercises using elastic bands can enhance post-activation performance in tennis players. This implies you can consider elastic band training as an effective pre-match warm-up or training alternative when heavy resistance equipment is unavailable.
items.limitation: 研究未明确提供具体的样本量和效果量数据，可能影响结果的精确解读。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly provide specific sample size and effect size data, which may affect the precise interpretation of the results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program on plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson’s disease: an exploratory analysis
items.summary: An exploratory analysis investigated the effect of a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program on plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson's disease, suggesting potential neurobiological benefits.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性分析提示，多学科强化门诊康复项目可能通过影响血浆神经丝和肌因子，对帕金森病患者产生积极的神经生物学效应。这为康复干预的机制研究提供了新的方向。
items.titleZh: 多学科强化门诊康复项目对帕金森病患者血浆神经丝和肌因子的影响：一项探索性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性分析研究了多学科强化门诊康复项目对帕金森病患者血浆神经丝和肌因子的影响，提示可能存在神经生物学益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory analysis suggests that multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation programs might exert positive neurobiological effects in Parkinson's disease by influencing plasma neurofilaments and myokines. This opens new avenues for mechanistic research into rehabilitation interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性分析，样本量和干预细节未在摘要中明确，需要进一步的验证性研究。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory analysis, and details regarding sample size and intervention specifics were not explicit in the abstract, warranting further confirmatory studies.

items.title: Assessing concerns about falling: a comparison of telephone-based and face-to-face FES-I interviews in older adults
items.summary: This study compared telephone-based and face-to-face interviews using the Falls Efficacy Scale-International (FES-I) for assessing concerns about falling in older adults, providing insights into assessment methods.
items.curatedReason: FES-I 的电话评估结果与面谈评估相似。这意味着你可以更灵活地选择评估方式，但仍需留意两种方法可能存在的细微差异，确保评估的准确性。
items.titleZh: 老年人跌倒顾虑评估：电话与面谈FES-I访谈的比较
items.summaryZh: 本研究比较了电话与面对面访谈方式在老年人跌倒效能国际量表（FES-I）评估跌倒顾虑方面的效果，为评估方法提供了见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telephone-based FES-I assessments yield similar results to face-to-face interviews. This offers flexibility in assessment methods, but you should still be mindful of potential subtle differences between the two approaches to ensure accuracy.
items.limitation: 研究结果的细节（如具体差异量、一致性指标）未在摘要中明确，需要查阅全文以评估两种评估方式的互换性。
items.limitationEn: Details of the study results (e.g., specific differences, agreement metrics) were not explicit in the abstract, requiring full text review to assess the interchangeability of the two assessment methods.

items.title: Neurology | American Board of Physical Therapy Education Residency and Fellowship
items.summary: The American Board of Physical Therapy Residency and Fellowship Education (ABPTRFE) has released a new Description of Residency Practice (DRP) for neurology to standardize curriculum and streamline accreditation for residency programs.
items.curatedReason: ABPTRFE 新发布的神经物理治疗 DRP 为住院医师项目提供了统一的课程标准。如果你负责神经康复住院医师的培训或认证，应立即参考这份文件，以确保符合最新要求并优化流程。
items.titleZh: 神经物理治疗 | 美国物理治疗教育住院医师和专科培训委员会
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗住院医师与专科培训委员会（ABPTRFE）发布了新的神经物理治疗住院医师实践描述（DRP），旨在统一课程标准并简化住院医师项目的认证流程。
items.curatedReasonEn: The new ABPTRFE neurology DRP standardizes curriculum for residency programs. If you're involved in training or accrediting neurology residents, you should consult this document immediately to ensure compliance with the latest requirements and optimize your processes.

items.title: Experiences of telehealth e-mentoring within postgraduate musculoskeletal physical therapy education in Canada and the United Kingdom.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the experiences of postgraduate physiotherapy mentees and mentors engaged in e-mentoring in Canada, comparing findings with the UK, to understand learning processes, outcomes, and challenges in musculoskeletal physical therapy education.
items.curatedReason: 远程电子导师制正在被北美和英国的 PT 硕士项目探索。了解其在不同文化背景下的应用经验，有助于你评估这种模式在你的教育或继续教育项目中的潜力。
items.titleZh: 加拿大和英国研究生肌肉骨骼物理治疗教育中远程电子导师制的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了加拿大研究生物理治疗学员和导师参与电子导师制的经验，并与英国的情况进行比较，旨在了解肌肉骨骼物理治疗教育中学习过程、感知结果和挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telehealth e-mentoring is being explored in North American and UK PT master's programs. Understanding its cross-cultural application experiences can help you evaluate this model's potential for your own educational or continuing education initiatives.
items.limitation: 本研究采用定性设计，未提供量化效果数据，且仅限于加拿大和英国的少数参与者经验。
items.limitationEn: This study employed a qualitative design, providing no quantitative effectiveness data, and is limited to experiences of a few participants in Canada and the UK.

items.title: Predicting gait patterns from actionable impairments in Duchenne muscular dystrophy: A Machine Learning and Explainable Artificial Intelligence study
items.summary: A machine learning study used actionable impairments to classify gait patterns in children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD), aiming to improve clinical decision-making by explaining how these impairments contribute to distinct gait patterns.
items.curatedReason: 对于DMD患儿，这项机器学习研究提示我们可以更早地识别出与特定步态模式相关的“可干预性缺陷”。虽然仍是观察性研究，但它可能为优化康复方案提供新的思路，指导你重点关注哪些步态特征。
items.titleZh: 通过杜氏肌营养不良症（DMD）的可干预缺陷预测步态模式：一项机器学习与可解释人工智能研究
items.summaryZh: 一项机器学习研究利用可干预缺陷对杜氏肌营养不良症（DMD）儿童的步态模式进行分类，旨在通过解释这些缺陷如何导致不同步态模式来改进临床决策。
items.curatedReasonEn: Predicting gait patterns in children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) using machine learning can aid clinical decision-making. This model helps you identify gait changes associated with actionable impairments earlier, optimizing rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性研究，可能存在数据收集偏倚，且模型结果的临床实用性和对患者结局的影响尚需前瞻性验证。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective study may be subject to data collection bias, and the clinical utility and impact of the model's predictions on patient outcomes require prospective validation.

items.title: A multimodal protocol for assessing real-world monitoring of lower-limb prosthesis use
items.summary: A multimodal protocol is described for assessing real-world lower-limb prosthesis use, integrating wearable and ambient sensing to capture functional performance, physiological effort, and lived experience beyond traditional outcome measures.
items.curatedReason: 该多模态协议的提出，意味着我们现在有工具能更全面地评估截肢者在真实世界中假肢的使用情况，而非仅限于实验室或自我报告。你应当开始思考如何将可穿戴和环境传感技术整合到日常评估中，以获得更真实的患者功能表现和生理负荷数据。
items.titleZh: 一种评估下肢假肢真实世界使用情况的多模态监测协议
items.summaryZh: 本协议描述了一种评估下肢假肢真实世界使用情况的多模态方法，整合了可穿戴和环境传感技术，以超越传统评估手段，捕捉功能表现、生理负荷和生活体验。
items.curatedReasonEn: The introduction of this multimodal protocol means we now have tools to more comprehensively assess real-world prosthesis use in amputees, beyond just lab settings or self-reports. You should start considering how to integrate wearable and ambient sensing technologies into your routine assessments to capture more authentic patient functional performance and physiological effort data.
items.limitation: 本研究为协议描述，尚未报告实际数据和结果，因此其在真实临床实践中的有效性和可行性尚待验证。
items.limitationEn: This study describes a protocol and has not yet reported actual data and results, so its effectiveness and feasibility in real clinical practice remain to be validated.

items.title: Comparison of high-intensity laser therapy and extracorporeal shock wave therapy for the treatment of plantar flexor spasticity in post-stroke patients.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 42 stroke patients compared high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) and radial extracorporeal shock wave therapy (rESWT) as adjunctive treatments for plantar flexor spasticity, with both groups showing greater improvements than rehabilitation alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了冲击波疗法和高强度激光疗法在卒中后足跖屈肌痉挛治疗中的比较证据。在临床实践中，可以根据患者具体情况和设备可及性，考虑将这两种疗法作为康复的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 比较高强度激光疗法与体外冲击波疗法在卒中后足跖屈肌痉挛治疗中的效果
items.summaryZh: 一项对 42 名卒中患者进行的随机对照试验比较了高强度激光疗法和体外冲击波疗法作为足跖屈肌痉挛的辅助治疗，结果显示两者均优于单独康复治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study offers comparative evidence for shockwave and high-intensity laser therapies in post-stroke plantar flexor spasticity. In clinical practice, consider these modalities as adjuncts based on patient needs and equipment availability.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 42 名患者，结果可能需要在大规模试验中进一步验证，且随访时间有限，无法评估长期效果。
items.limitationEn: With a sample size of 42 patients, results may require validation in larger trials, and limited follow-up prevents long-term effect evaluation.

items.title: Physical therapists as first-contact providers for musculoskeletal disorders: comparing beliefs across chiropractors, nurse practitioners, Physical therapists, and physician assistants.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey compared beliefs among chiropractors, nurse practitioners, physical therapists, and physician assistants regarding their capabilities, education, and scope of practice for first-contact care of musculoskeletal disorders.
items.curatedReason: 理解其他初级接触提供者（FCPs）对物理治疗师（PTs）在肌肉骨骼疾病（MSKDs）一线治疗中能力的看法，有助于识别并克服将 PTs 整合到 FCP 角色中的障碍。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师作为肌肉骨骼疾病初级接触提供者：比较脊椎按摩师、执业护士、物理治疗师和医师助理的信念
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面调查比较了脊椎按摩师、执业护士、物理治疗师和医师助理对各自在肌肉骨骼疾病初级接触护理中的能力、教育准备和执业范围的看法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding other first-contact providers' (FCPs) beliefs about physical therapists' (PTs) capabilities in MSKD first-contact care helps identify and overcome barriers to integrating PTs into FCP roles.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，仅反映了特定时间点的信念差异，无法评估因果关系或态度的长期变化。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey reflects beliefs at a specific point, thus cannot assess causality or long-term attitude changes.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Functional Electrical Stimulation and Stroke Rehabilitation Research: The Critical Role of Sham Control Groups.
items.summary: This perspective piece emphasizes the critical need for robust sham control groups in functional electrical stimulation (FES) research for stroke rehabilitation to ensure valid conclusions.
items.curatedReason: 本述评强调在功能性电刺激（FES）卒中康复研究中，严格的安慰剂对照组设计至关重要，以确保结果的有效性。在评估新的FES干预方案时，你需要审慎考察其对照组的设置，确保其能有效隔离非特异性效应。
items.titleZh: 功能性电刺激与卒中康复研究：安慰剂对照组的关键作用
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评强调，在卒中康复的功能性电刺激（FES）研究中，设计严格的安慰剂对照组对于确保研究结论的有效性至关重要。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights the critical role of rigorous sham control groups in functional electrical stimulation (FES) stroke rehabilitation research to ensure result validity. When evaluating new FES interventions, scrutinize the design of their control groups to ensure non-specific effects are effectively isolated.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: The use of eHealth in primary physiotherapy care: a mixed-method study.
items.summary: A mixed-methods study with 121 Danish primary care physiotherapists found common use of basic eHealth tools like email and telephone, while more advanced technologies were rarely adopted, identifying perceived barriers and facilitators.
items.curatedReason: 丹麦初级物理治疗师普遍使用电子邮件和电话等基础eHealth工具，但对更复杂的工具接受度不高。这提示，在推动eHealth工具应用时，我们应更关注用户体验和实际障碍，而非一味推广技术。
items.titleZh: 初级物理治疗中电子健康（eHealth）的使用：一项混合方法研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 121 名丹麦初级物理治疗师进行的混合方法研究发现，邮件和电话等基础电子健康工具被普遍使用，但更先进的技术应用较少，研究识别了其应用障碍和促进因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Danish primary care physiotherapists commonly use basic eHealth tools like email and telephone, yet advanced technologies see limited adoption. This suggests that future eHealth implementation strategies should focus on user experience and identified barriers, rather than just technology promotion.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限丹麦初级物理治疗师，且为混合方法，样本量相对较小，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study included only Danish primary care physiotherapists with a mixed-methods design and a relatively small sample size, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Associations of Walk-and-Turn Spatiotemporal Gait Parameters With Functional Mobility in Children With Cerebral Palsy at GMFCS Levels I and II
items.summary: This study found that spatiotemporal gait parameters during a 5-meter walk-and-turn task, along with lower extremity strength and range of motion, are associated with functional mobility and GMFCS levels in ambulatory children with cerebral palsy.
items.curatedReason: 步态参数、下肢肌力和活动度与脑瘫儿童的功能活动能力直接相关，评估时不可忽视这些指标。
items.titleZh: 脑瘫I、II级患儿步态时空参数与功能移动性的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，在5米步行-转弯任务中评估的步态时空参数，以及下肢肌力和活动度受限，与I、II级脑瘫患儿的功能移动性及粗大运动功能分级系统（GMFCS）水平相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Spatiotemporal gait parameters, lower extremity strength, and range of motion are directly associated with functional mobility in children with cerebral palsy; these metrics should not be overlooked during assessments.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在未报告的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality and may have unreported confounding factors.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Protective Techniques and Postural Strategies for Individuals With Blindness or Low Vision: A Guide for Clinicians and Patients
items.summary: This guide outlines protective techniques and postural strategies for individuals with blindness or low vision, aiming to mitigate the higher risk of collisions, falls, and upper-body injuries they face.
items.curatedReason: 为视障人士提供专门的防护技术和姿势指导，能显著降低他们发生碰撞、跌倒及上身受伤的风险。
items.titleZh: 盲人或低视力患者的防护技术与姿势策略：临床医生与患者指南
items.summaryZh: 本指南为盲人或低视力患者提供了防护技术和姿势策略，以降低他们在日常活动中面临的碰撞、跌倒及头/上身受伤的高风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: Providing specialized protective techniques and postural guidance for individuals with blindness or low vision can significantly reduce their risk of collisions, falls, and upper-body injuries.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Screening sham mirror-therapy materials using fNIRS: protocol for an acute within-participant randomised crossover mechanistic study
items.summary: This protocol describes a randomized crossover fNIRS screening study designed to identify the most "neutral" sham mirror-therapy material condition by comparing its neural signature to true mirror visual feedback in healthy adults.
items.curatedReason: RCT 设计提示，通过 fNIRS 比较不同“假性”镜像疗法材料的神经信号，有助于在临床试验中选择更精确的安慰剂对照。
items.titleZh: 使用fNIRS筛选假性镜像疗法材料：一项急性自身对照随机交叉机制研究的方案
items.summaryZh: 本研究方案描述了一项急性、自身对照、随机交叉的fNIRS筛选研究，旨在通过比较健康成年人在真实镜像视觉反馈和三种预设假性材料条件下的神经信号，识别出“最中性”的假性镜像疗法材料。
items.curatedReasonEn: The RCT design suggests that comparing neural signals from different "sham" mirror therapy materials using fNIRS can aid in selecting more precise placebo controls in clinical trials.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步的机制探索协议，旨在筛选安慰剂材料，而非评估疗法疗效。
items.limitationEn: This study is a preliminary mechanistic exploration protocol, aiming to screen placebo materials rather than evaluate therapeutic efficacy.

items.title: Understanding how demographic characteristics impact the level of physical activity children with neuromotor impairments experience while using a robot-assisted walker
items.summary: This prospective study aims to examine how robot-assisted walkers' physical parameters and user characteristics moderate the exercise intensity achieved by individuals with pediatric-onset neuromotor disorders causing mobility impairments.
items.curatedReason: 理解人口学特征如何影响机器人辅助步行对儿童的运动强度，有助于你为患有神经运动障碍的儿童患者更精准地定制康复方案和优化机器人辅助设备的使用。
items.titleZh: 了解人口学特征如何影响神经运动障碍儿童使用机器人辅助步行器的体力活动水平
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性研究旨在探讨机器人辅助步行器的物理参数和用户特征如何调节患有儿童期神经运动障碍导致行动不便的个体所达到的运动强度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding how demographic characteristics impact the level of physical activity children experience with robot-assisted walkers can help you more precisely tailor rehabilitation programs and optimize the use of robotic assistive devices for pediatric patients with neuromotor impairments.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性单次干预，可能无法反映长期使用效果，且样本量较小。
items.limitationEn: This is a prospective, single-session intervention study, which may not reflect long-term effects and has a small sample size.

items.title: Early Emergence of Abnormal Muscle Synergies in the Human Upper Extremity Following Stroke
items.summary: This cross-sectional study investigated the early emergence and characteristics of abnormal muscle synergies in the upper extremity of 39 individuals with hemiparesis in the early subacute period (<6 months) after stroke.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后早期 (<6个月) 即可观察到异常的肩胛带肌协同模式，提示应尽早开始针对这些模式的干预。
items.titleZh: 卒中后人类上肢异常肌肉协同模式的早期出现
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究调查了39名卒中后早期亚急性期（<6个月）偏瘫患者上肢异常肌肉协同模式的早期出现及其特征。
items.curatedReasonEn: Abnormal upper extremity muscle synergies emerge early after stroke (<6 months), suggesting that interventions targeting these patterns should be initiated as soon as possible.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法确定异常协同模式与长期功能预后之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot determine the causal relationship between abnormal synergy patterns and long-term functional outcomes.

items.title: A grade-specific clinical prediction rule for independent walking after traumatic spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A clinical prediction rule was developed using the National Spinal Cord Injury Statistical Centre dataset (2607 patients) to predict independent walking one year after traumatic spinal cord injury, with differentiated prognoses for individual ASIA Impairment Scale grades.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对创伤性脊髓损伤患者的临床预测规则，能基于 AIS 分级提供一年后独立步行的差异化预后。在早期评估和制定康复目标时，你可以利用这个工具，与患者及其家属进行更精确的沟通。
items.titleZh: 创伤性脊髓损伤后独立步行的分级临床预测规则
items.summaryZh: 一项基于国家脊髓损伤统计中心数据集（2607 名患者）的研究，开发了创伤性脊髓损伤后一年内独立步行的临床预测规则，为不同 ASIA 损伤分级患者提供差异化预后。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical prediction rule for traumatic spinal cord injury provides differentiated prognoses for independent walking one year post-injury, based on AIS grades. You can use this tool for more precise communication with patients and families during early assessment and goal setting.
items.limitation: 此预测规则是基于大型数据集构建的，但其在不同人群和临床环境中的外部验证仍需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: While built on a large dataset, the external validation of this prediction rule across diverse populations and clinical settings warrants further investigation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: A grade-specific clinical prediction rule for independent walking after traumatic spinal cord injury

items.title: Musculoskeletal impairments associated with migraine in young adults: a case-control study.
items.summary: A case-control study of 140 university students found associations between migraine and reduced core and cervical muscle endurance, as well as craniovertebral angle, even after adjusting for age, sex, and BMI.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示年轻偏头痛患者的颈部和核心肌群耐力可能与疾病相关。在评估偏头痛患者时，你应将这些肌肉骨骼因素纳入考量。
items.titleZh: 年轻偏头痛患者的肌肉骨骼障碍：一项病例对照研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 140 名大学生的病例对照研究发现，偏头痛与核心肌群和颈部肌群耐力下降以及颅椎角异常相关，即使在调整了年龄、性别和体重指数后，这些关联依然存在。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that cervical and core muscle endurance may be associated with migraine in young adults. Consider these musculoskeletal factors when assessing patients with migraine.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例对照设计，无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This case-control study cannot establish causality.

items.title: How occupational therapists integrate robotic therapy into routine practice: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored how seven occupational therapists in Bangkok integrated robotic hand exoskeleton therapy into stroke rehabilitation, identifying themes such as client readiness, motivation, and individualized therapy, alongside challenges and facilitators.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了职业治疗师将机器人手部外骨骼疗法整合到卒中康复实践中的经验。了解其他治疗师如何处理患者准备、依从性和个体化方案，有助于你更有效地采纳新技术。
items.titleZh: 职业治疗师如何将机器人疗法整合到常规实践中：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了曼谷七名职业治疗师如何将机器人手部外骨骼疗法整合到卒中康复中，研究发现的关键主题包括患者准备、动机、个体化治疗，以及实施中的挑战与促进因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals how occupational therapists integrate robotic hand exoskeleton therapy into stroke rehabilitation. Understanding how other therapists manage client readiness, adherence, and individualized programs can help you adopt new technologies more effectively.
items.limitation: 本研究是定性研究，样本量小且集中在特定地区，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: As a qualitative study with a small sample from a specific region, the generalizability of these findings is limited.

items.title: Associations of motor recovery and perceived social support with participation-related outcomes in chronic stroke.
items.summary: A single-session assessment of 40 community-dwelling individuals with chronic stroke and 41 healthy controls found that motor recovery and perceived social support were associated with participation-related outcomes such as life satisfaction and health-related quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 本研究强调了运动恢复和感知社会支持对慢性卒中患者参与相关结局的重要性。在制定康复计划时，除了关注身体功能，也应考虑患者的社会支持系统，以提升生活满意度和生活质量。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中患者运动恢复和感知社会支持与参与相关结局的关联
items.summaryZh: 对 40 名社区慢性卒中患者和 41 名健康对照者进行单次评估发现，运动恢复和感知社会支持与生活满意度和健康相关生活质量等参与相关结局存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights the importance of motor recovery and perceived social support for participation-related outcomes in chronic stroke patients. When developing rehabilitation plans, consider patients' social support systems alongside physical function to improve life satisfaction and quality of life.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法确立因果关系；且其样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality and has a relatively small sample size.

items.title: Modest Payment Increases Finalized by CMS for SNFs and IRFs
items.summary: CMS finalized modest payment increases for Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) and Inpatient Rehabilitation Facilities (IRFs) for fiscal year 2027, while introducing earlier deadlines for care initiation and interdisciplinary team meetings for IRFs, and requiring all-payer Minimum Data Set submissions for SNFs starting October 1.
items.curatedReason: CMS（美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心）公布了2027财年SNF（专业护理机构）和IRF（住院康复机构）的最终支付规则，支付增幅温和，但引入了更严格的照护启动和团队会议截止日期，并要求SNF收集所有支付方的MDS数据。这会显著增加机构的行政负担，你需密切关注并调整工作流程以符合新规，特别是关于记录和跨学科协作的要求。
items.titleZh: CMS 最终确定 SNF 和 IRF 适度支付增长。
items.summaryZh: CMS最终确定了2027财年SNF和IRF的适度支付增长，同时为IRF设定了更早的照护启动和跨学科团队会议截止日期，并要求SNF从10月1日起提交所有支付方的最低数据集（MDS）。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has finalized its FY 2027 payment rules for SNFs and IRFs, with modest payment increases but stricter deadlines for care initiation and interdisciplinary team meetings, and requiring SNFs to collect all-payer MDS submissions. This will significantly increase administrative burden for facilities, and you need to monitor closely and adjust workflows to comply with new regulations, especially regarding documentation and interdisciplinary collaboration.

items.title: Biofeedback in Parkinson's disease: A systematic review with meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analysis of randomized trials found that adding biofeedback to practice effectively improves lower limb activity in people with Parkinson's disease compared to practice alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量系统综述明确指出，生物反馈对改善帕金森病患者的下肢活动能力是有效的。你应该考虑在常规训练中加入生物反馈，以期提升患者的平衡和步态表现。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病中的生物反馈：一项系统综述与Meta分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对帕金森病患者的随机试验系统综述与Meta分析显示，在训练中加入生物反馈能有效改善下肢活动能力，优于单独训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review clearly indicates that biofeedback effectively improves lower limb activity in people with Parkinson's disease. You should consider incorporating biofeedback into routine practice to enhance your patients' balance and gait performance.
items.limitation: 具体生物反馈类型、训练强度和持续时间的异质性可能影响结果的解读和临床应用。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in specific biofeedback types, training intensity, and duration may affect the interpretation and clinical application of results.

items.title: Physical Therapy Management of Fall Risk in Community-Dwelling Older Adults (CPG+)
items.summary: APTA Geriatrics has released an updated clinical practice guideline for physical therapy management of fall risk in community-dwelling adults aged 65 and over, replacing the 2015 version and effective April 1, 2025.
items.curatedReason: APTA老年病学分会发布了社区老年人跌倒风险管理临床实践指南的更新版（2025年4月1日生效）。这取代了2015年的版本，提供了更全面的循证建议，你应立即更新你的跌倒风险评估与干预方案。
items.titleZh: 社区老年人跌倒风险的物理治疗管理（CPG+）。
items.summaryZh: APTA老年病学分会发布了社区65岁及以上老年人跌倒风险物理治疗管理的新版临床实践指南，取代2015年版本，并于2025年4月1日生效。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA Geriatrics has released an updated Clinical Practice Guideline for managing fall risk in community-dwelling older adults, effective April 1, 2025. This replaces the 2015 version and provides comprehensive evidence-based recommendations; you should update your fall risk assessment and intervention protocols immediately.

items.title: Extended-Window Thrombolysis Improves Stroke Outcomes with increased bleeding risk: JAMA
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 RCTs (N=4,174) found that intravenous thrombolysis given ≥4.5 hours after acute ischemic stroke onset improved functional outcomes (NNT 12–16) but increased symptomatic intracerebral hemorrhage (RR 2.44, NNH 62).
items.curatedReason: 这项涵盖4,174名患者的系统综述证实，急性缺血性卒中溶栓窗口延长至4.5小时后仍能改善功能，NNT为12-16。尽管颅内出血风险（NNH 62）增加，但对部分患者来说，这仍值得你密切关注其溶栓后的康复进展。
items.titleZh: 延长时间窗溶栓改善卒中结局，但出血风险增加：JAMA。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含14项随机试验（4,174名患者）的系统综述和Meta分析发现，急性缺血性卒中发作4.5小时后进行的静脉溶栓能改善功能预后（NNT 12–16），但会增加症状性颅内出血风险（RR 2.44，NNH 62）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review of 4,174 patients confirms that intravenous thrombolysis for acute ischemic stroke, even ≥4.5 hours post-onset, improves functional outcomes (NNT 12–16). Despite increased intracerebral hemorrhage risk (NNH 62), you should closely monitor post-thrombolysis rehabilitation for select patients.
items.limitation: 研究指出，延长时间窗溶栓的出血风险增加，提示临床决策需平衡获益与风险。
items.limitationEn: The study notes an increased bleeding risk with extended-window thrombolysis, indicating that clinical decisions require balancing benefits and risks.

items.title: Characteristics of Outpatient Care Settings Associated with Implementation Outcomes for a Group Physical Therapy Program.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of a cluster randomized trial assessed associations between organizational and contextual characteristics and implementation of group physical therapy for knee osteoarthritis in 19 VHA outpatient PT departments.
items.curatedReason: 这项二次分析提示，在VHA的19个门诊PT部门推广膝骨关节炎小组物理治疗时，组织和情境因素比你想象的更关键。成功推行一个项目，不仅关乎疗效，更在于能否有效处理好管理和环境因素。
items.titleZh: 门诊护理环境中与小组物理治疗项目实施结果相关的特征。
items.summaryZh: 一项对19个退伍军人事务部（VHA）门诊物理治疗部门的二次分析研究发现，组织和情境特征与膝骨关节炎小组物理治疗项目的实施结果相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This secondary analysis suggests that organizational and contextual factors are more critical than you might think for implementing group physical therapy for knee OA in 19 VHA outpatient PT departments. Successful program rollout isn't just about efficacy; it's about effectively managing administrative and environmental elements.
items.limitation: 本研究为二次分析，受限于原始集群随机试验的设计和数据。
items.limitationEn: This study is a secondary analysis, limited by the design and data of the original cluster randomized trial.

items.title: Person-centred working relationships that focus on the unique goals of the individual are the heart of supported self-management: a qualitative study with stroke survivors.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 21 stroke survivors in England found that person-centred working relationships focused on unique individual goals are central to supported self-management during community stroke rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调了以患者为中心的工作关系（治疗联盟）在卒中幸存者自我管理中的核心作用。这提示你在社区卒中康复中，应优先建立基于个体独特目标的良好治疗关系。
items.titleZh: 以个体独特目标为中心的工作关系是支持性自我管理的核心：一项针对卒中幸存者的定性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对21名英国卒中幸存者的定性研究发现，以患者为中心的工作关系（治疗联盟）是社区卒中康复中支持性自我管理的核心。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the core role of person-centred working relationships (therapeutic alliance) in stroke survivors' self-management. This suggests that in community stroke rehabilitation, you should prioritize establishing strong therapeutic relationships based on individual goals.
items.limitation: 作为定性研究，其结果的普遍性有限，主要反映了21名英国卒中幸存者的个体经验。
items.limitationEn: As a qualitative study, its generalizability is limited, reflecting the individual experiences of 21 stroke survivors in England.

items.title: Towards global standards in stroke rehabilitation and recovery: An international evaluation of practice alignment.
items.summary: A mixed-methods study involving 15 international stroke rehabilitation centers from 10 countries evaluated the alignment of their routine clinical practices with Centres of Clinical Excellence criteria.
items.curatedReason: 来自10个国家的15个卒中康复中心的数据显示，即便在国际层面，临床实践与“临床卓越中心”标准的符合度也参差不齐。这表明，要达到卓越标准，我们还有很长的路要走，而且不同医疗体系下的挑战各不相同。
items.titleZh: 迈向卒中康复与恢复的全球标准：一项国际实践对齐评估。
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖10个国家15个国际卒中康复中心的混合方法研究评估了其常规临床实践与“临床卓越中心”标准的符合度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Data from 15 stroke rehabilitation centers across 10 countries reveal varied alignment of clinical practices with 'Centres of Clinical Excellence' criteria, even internationally. This indicates a long road ahead to achieve excellence, with distinct challenges across different healthcare systems.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（15个中心），且结果可能受限于参与中心的自我报告和研究者的解释。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small (15 centers), and results may be limited by self-reporting from participating centers and researcher interpretation.

items.title: Impact of modified subvastus approach versus limited medial parapatellar approach on early recovery after minimally invasive total knee arthroplasty: a retrospective comparative study
items.summary: A retrospective comparative study assessed early clinical outcomes between a modified subvastus approach and a limited medial parapatellar approach in minimally invasive total knee arthroplasty.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性比较研究提示，在微创全膝关节置换术中，改良股内侧肌下入路与有限髌旁内侧入路对早期临床结果可能存在差异。这意味着你早期康复策略的制定，应考虑患者的具体手术入路。
items.titleZh: 改良股内侧肌下入路与有限髌旁内侧入路对微创全膝关节置换术后早期恢复的影响：一项回顾性比较研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性研究比较了微创全膝关节置换术中改良股内侧肌下入路与有限髌旁内侧入路对早期临床结果的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective comparative study suggests potential differences in early clinical outcomes between a modified subvastus approach and a limited medial parapatellar approach in minimally invasive total knee arthroplasty. This means your early rehabilitation strategy should account for the patient's specific surgical approach.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性设计，存在选择偏倚，且仅关注早期恢复，长期效果尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: This study is retrospective, subject to selection bias, and focused only on early recovery, with long-term effects remaining unclear.

items.title: Method comparison of a ring-based PPG device and a chest-strap monitor for heart rate and heart rate variability in shooting athletes
items.summary: This study examined the device-to-device agreement between a ring-based photoplethysmography (PPG) device and a chest-strap monitor for heart rate and heart rate variability in shooting athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这项对射击运动员的研究表明，环式PPG设备在心率和心率变异性测量上与胸带监护仪存在一定差异。如果你在监测高精度运动表现，请谨慎评估环式设备的精确度，它可能无法完全替代金标准胸带。
items.titleZh: 环式PPG设备与胸带监护仪在射击运动员心率和心率变异性测量上的方法学比较。
items.summaryZh: 本研究评估了环式光电容积描记（PPG）设备与胸带监护仪在射击运动员心率和心率变异性测量上的一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study in shooting athletes shows some discrepancies between ring-based PPG devices and chest-strap monitors for heart rate and heart rate variability. If you're monitoring high-precision athletic performance, carefully assess the accuracy of ring-based devices; they may not fully replace the gold-standard chest strap.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于射击运动员这一特定人群和特定的运动环境，其结果可能无法直接外推至其他运动或更剧烈的活动类型。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to shooting athletes and a specific sport setting; its results may not be directly generalizable to other sports or more intense activities.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The association between intrinsic capacity and quality of life in community-dwelling older adults: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study investigated the association between intrinsic capacity and quality of life in community-dwelling older adults, finding a significant relationship.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面研究发现社区老年人的内在能力与生活质量之间存在关联。它提示你在评估和干预老年患者时，应更全面地考虑其内在能力（如认知、营养、活动能力等），以提升其整体生活质量。
items.titleZh: 社区老年人内在能力与生活质量的关联：一项横断面研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究发现，在社区居住的老年人中，内在能力与生活质量之间存在显著关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study found an association between intrinsic capacity and quality of life in community-dwelling older adults. It suggests that when assessing and intervening with older patients, you should consider their intrinsic capacity (e.g., cognition, nutrition, mobility) more holistically to improve their overall quality of life.
items.limitation: 作为横断面研究，本研究只能揭示内在能力与生活质量的关联性，无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, this research can only reveal associations between intrinsic capacity and quality of life, not establish causality.

items.title: Feasibility and acceptability of a randomized controlled trial of a patient-centred transition program for stroke survivors and their caregivers-P-NAVISTROKE study.
items.summary: A pilot RCT (n=28 stroke survivors, 9 caregivers) found a patient-centered transition program combining an information platform and case manager follow-up to be feasible and acceptable for psychosocial recovery during hospital-to-home transition.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点 RCT 表明，针对卒中幸存者及其照护者的患者中心化过渡康复项目是可行的且可被接受的，尤其在心理社会康复方面。这提示了未来更大规模研究的方向，但目前尚不足以直接改变临床实践。
items.titleZh: P-NAVISTROKE 研究：卒中幸存者及其照护者患者中心化过渡项目随机对照试验的可行性与接受度
items.summaryZh: 一项试点随机对照试验（28 名卒中幸存者，9 名照护者）发现，结合信息平台和个案经理随访的患者中心化过渡项目，对于卒中患者从医院到家庭的心理社会康复具有可行性和可接受性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT indicates that a patient-centered transition rehabilitation program for stroke survivors and their caregivers is feasible and acceptable, particularly regarding psychosocial recovery. This points towards directions for larger future studies but is not yet sufficient to directly change clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的试点随机对照试验，主要评估可行性和接受度，而非临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample pilot randomized controlled trial primarily assessing feasibility and acceptability, not clinical efficacy.

items.title: Effects of Fingertip Vibrotactile Stimulation on Postural Control in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: A Comparison Across Age Groups
items.summary: Fingertip vibrotactile stimulation improved postural control in community-dwelling older adults (age 65-84 years), but the effect was less pronounced in the oldest-old group (85+ years) based on COP velocity and area measurements.
items.curatedReason: 指尖振动刺激可改善老年人的姿势控制，但对最年长组（85 岁以上）的效应可能减弱，提示干预方案需考虑年龄差异。用于临床实践时，注意其在极高龄人群中的实际效益边界。
items.titleZh: 指尖振动刺激对社区老年人姿势控制的影响：不同年龄组的比较
items.summaryZh: 一项对 348 名社区老年人（65-74 岁、75-84 岁、85 岁及以上）的研究发现，指尖振动刺激改善了 65-84 岁老年人的姿势控制（通过 COP 速度和区域衡量），但对 85 岁及以上人群效果不明显。
items.curatedReasonEn: Fingertip vibrotactile stimulation improves postural control in older adults, but its effect may diminish in the oldest-old (85+ years), suggesting age-specific intervention considerations. When applying clinically, be mindful of its efficacy limits in the very elderly.
items.limitation: 研究未明确报告刺激方案的详细参数和长期效应，仅关注短期的姿势控制指标。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly report detailed parameters of the stimulation protocol or long-term effects, focusing only on short-term postural control metrics.

items.title: Carrying an unseen weight: the neuro-perceptual landscape of limb heaviness after stroke- a scoping review.
items.summary: This scoping review maps the evidence on perceived limb heaviness after stroke, identifying it as an under-recognized symptom associated with altered sensorimotor integration, impaired proprioception, and disrupted body representation, which current assessments often miss.
items.curatedReason: 本综述首次系统地描绘了卒中后“肢体沉重感”这一常被忽视但影响深远的主观症状的神经知觉机制。它提示你，在评估和干预卒中患者时，除了传统运动/感觉缺损，还需关注这种基于本体感觉和躯体表征异常的感知障碍，这会影响患者的依从性和康复效果。
items.titleZh: 卒中后肢体沉重感的神经知觉机制：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述系统地梳理了卒中后肢体沉重感的现有证据，指出其是因感觉运动整合异常、本体感觉受损和躯体表征紊乱引起的未被充分认识的症状，且常规评估常无法检测。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review systematically maps the neuro-perceptual landscape of perceived limb heaviness after stroke, an often-overlooked but impactful subjective symptom. It suggests that, beyond traditional motor/sensory deficits, clinicians must also consider this perceptual disturbance rooted in altered proprioception and body representation when assessing and intervening with stroke patients, as it can affect adherence and rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，未能提供量化的效应大小和干预建议，仅基于现有文献的叙述性综合。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review provides a narrative synthesis of existing literature and does not offer quantified effect sizes or specific intervention recommendations.

items.title: Application of non-invasive electroencephalogram-based brain-computer interfaces in post-stroke hand function rehabilitation.
items.summary: This article reviews the application of non-invasive EEG-based brain-computer interfaces (BCI) in post-stroke hand function rehabilitation, explaining how BCI decodes imagined hand movements to drive exoskeletons, FES, or VR, thereby strengthening neural pathways and promoting motor recovery.
items.curatedReason: 脑机接口（BCI）是卒中后手功能康复的新兴方向，对于传统康复难以奏效的无主动运动能力患者尤为关键。它为你展示了基于 EEG 的 BCI 如何通过意念驱动外部设备，有望重塑受损神经通路，为难治性卒中手功能障碍提供突破口。
items.titleZh: 非侵入性 EEG 脑机接口在卒中后手功能康复中的应用
items.summaryZh: 本文综述了非侵入性 EEG 脑机接口（BCI）在卒中后手功能康复中的应用，阐述了 BCI 如何通过解码意念运动驱动外骨骼、FES 或 VR 设备，以强化神经通路并促进运动恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: Brain-computer interfaces (BCI) represent an emerging direction for post-stroke hand function rehabilitation, especially crucial for patients lacking active movement who don't benefit from conventional therapy. This article illustrates how EEG-based BCI, by driving external devices with imagined movements, holds promise for reshaping damaged neural pathways, offering a breakthrough for refractory stroke-related hand dysfunction.
items.limitation: 这是一篇综述，主要关注技术原理和应用前景，缺乏具体的临床试验数据和效果量化。
items.limitationEn: This is a review primarily focusing on technical principles and potential applications, lacking specific clinical trial data and quantified outcomes.

items.title: Strengthening Cardiac Rehabilitation: Key Strategies for Enhancing Accessibility and Outcomes
items.summary: This study identified key strategies for strengthening cardiac rehabilitation programs from interviews with 10 leaders of high-performing sites, revealing common themes like patient-centered education, personalized exercise plans, and proactive support to overcome barriers, which are associated with improved participation and adherence.
items.curatedReason: 这份初步研究揭示了表现优异的心脏康复项目在提高参与度和依从性方面的共性策略，例如患者教育、个性化方案和克服障碍支持。你可以从中借鉴这些实践经验，思考如何在自己的项目中优化患者管理和支持，以提升康复依从性。
items.titleZh: 强化心脏康复：提升可及性和疗效的关键策略
items.summaryZh: 本研究通过对 10 位高绩效心脏康复项目领导者的访谈，识别了强化心脏康复的关键策略，揭示了以患者为中心的教育、个性化运动方案和积极支持克服障碍等共同主题，这些策略与更高的参与度和依从性相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study identifies common strategies used by high-performing cardiac rehabilitation programs to boost participation and adherence, such as patient education, personalized plans, and support for overcoming barriers. You can draw upon these practical insights to optimize patient management and support within your own programs, thereby improving rehabilitation adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（10 名 CR 领导者），为定性访谈形式，其结果的普遍适用性有待进一步大规模验证。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (10 CR leaders) and is based on qualitative interviews, so the generalizability of its findings requires further large-scale validation.

items.title: [Viewpoint] Risk of transmission of amyloid β pathology via transfused blood products
items.summary: This viewpoint discusses concerns about the potential transmission of amyloid β pathology, relevant to Alzheimer's disease, via transfused blood products, drawing parallels with iatrogenic Creutzfeldt–Jakob disease and past medical procedures.
items.curatedReason: 这篇观点文章探讨了阿尔茨海默病中淀粉样蛋白 β 病理通过输血传播的潜在风险。虽然属于神经科范畴，但它提出了对既往医源性传播（如生长激素治疗）的关注，以及未来对血制品筛选的潜在影响，为你关注的神经退行性疾病风险管理提供了新视角。
items.titleZh: 观点：输血制品传播淀粉样蛋白 β 病理的风险
items.summaryZh: 这篇观点文章讨论了通过输血制品传播与阿尔茨海默病相关的淀粉样蛋白 β 病理的潜在风险，并将其与医源性克雅氏病及过往医疗操作进行了比较。
items.curatedReasonEn: This viewpoint discusses the potential risk of amyloid β pathology transmission via transfused blood products in Alzheimer's disease. While neurological, it highlights concerns regarding past iatrogenic transmissions (e.g., growth hormone therapy) and potential future implications for blood product screening, offering a new perspective on neurodegenerative disease risk management.

items.title: White Matter Diffusion Anisotropy and the Effects of Inpatient Multidisciplinary Rehabilitation in Parkinson's Disease: A Diffusion Tensor Imaging Analysis.
items.summary: This study investigated whether pretreatment corticospinal tract (CST) fractional anisotropy (FA) predicts inpatient rehabilitation response in 94 Parkinson's disease patients. Patients were classified as responders (UPDRS Part III improvement ≥2.5 points; n=61) or non-responders (n=33).
items.curatedReason: 对于帕金森病患者，治疗前的皮质脊髓束（CST）分数各向异性（FA）可能预示住院康复效果。这项观察研究提示，FA值或许能帮助我们区分康复的“响应者”（61人）与“无响应者”（33人），从而更精准地制定个体化康复策略。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者白质弥散各向异性与住院多学科康复效果的关系：一项弥散张量成像分析
items.summaryZh: 这项研究探讨了帕金森病患者入院前皮质脊髓束 (CST) 分数各向异性 (FA) 是否能预测住院康复效果。研究纳入 94 例患者，根据 UPDRS Part III 评分改善情况分为康复应答者 (n=61) 和非应答者 (n=33)。
items.curatedReasonEn: Pretreatment corticospinal tract (CST) fractional anisotropy (FA) may predict inpatient rehabilitation response in Parkinson's disease patients. This observational study suggests FA values could help differentiate rehabilitation 'responders' (n=61) from 'non-responders' (n=33), potentially leading to more precise, individualized rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（94 例 PD 患者），且仅限于住院多学科康复项目。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a relatively small sample size (94 PD patients) and was limited to an inpatient multidisciplinary rehabilitation program.

items.title: [Articles] Liver resection after atezolizumab and bevacizumab versus maintenance therapy for locally advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (TALENTOP): a multicentre, open-label, randomised, phase 3 trial
items.summary: A multicenter, open-label, randomized, phase 3 trial (TALENTOP) found that liver resection after atezolizumab and bevacizumab prolonged time to treatment failure compared to maintenance therapy for patients with locally advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with macrovascular invasion.
items.curatedReason: 这项三期临床试验提示，对于伴有大血管侵犯的局部晚期肝细胞癌患者，在全身治疗后进行肝切除术可能比单纯维持治疗更能延长治疗失败时间。这为物理治疗师提供了背景信息，了解此类患者的治疗路径及其预后考量。
items.titleZh: TALENTOP：阿替利珠单抗联合贝伐珠单抗后肝切除术与维持治疗用于局部晚期肝细胞癌的3期随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心、开放标签、随机、3期临床试验（TALENTOP）发现，对于伴有大血管侵犯的局部晚期肝细胞癌患者，阿替利珠单抗联合贝伐珠单抗后进行肝切除术，相比单纯维持治疗，能延长治疗失败时间。
items.curatedReasonEn: This phase 3 trial suggests that liver resection after systemic therapy, compared to maintenance therapy alone, may prolong time to treatment failure for patients with locally advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with macrovascular invasion. This provides physical therapists with background on the treatment pathways for these patients and their prognostic considerations.
items.limitation: 本研究为开放标签设计，可能存在一定偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This study used an open-label design, which may introduce some bias.

items.title: Clinical and neurophysiological determinants of response to contralesional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation after stroke: A systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis confirmed the efficacy of contralesional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (LF-rTMS) for post-stroke upper-limb rehabilitation and identified baseline motor impairment severity and corticospinal tract integrity as key modifiers of treatment effects.
items.curatedReason: 对侧低频重复经颅磁刺激 (LF-rTMS) 对卒中后上肢康复确实有效。现在，你应该更关注患者的基线运动障碍严重程度和皮质脊髓束完整性，这能帮你更好地筛选出最适合 LF-rTMS 治疗的患者，从而提升干预效果。
items.titleZh: 卒中后对侧低频重复经颅磁刺激反应的临床和神经生理学决定因素：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析证实了对侧低频重复经颅磁刺激 (LF-rTMS) 在卒中后上肢康复中的疗效，并指出基线运动障碍严重程度和皮质脊髓束完整性是治疗效果的关键调节因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis affirms the efficacy of contralesional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (LF-rTMS) in post-stroke upper-limb rehabilitation and identifies baseline motor impairment severity and corticospinal tract integrity as key treatment effect modifiers. This guides you to consider these neurophysiological indicators when selecting rTMS interventions to enhance treatment precision and effectiveness.
items.limitation: 荟萃分析的局限性在于其结果质量受限于纳入研究的异质性和潜在发表偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of a meta-analysis is that the quality of its results is constrained by the heterogeneity and potential publication bias of the included studies.

items.title: Development and psychometric validation of the shoulder problems assessment scale.
items.summary: Researchers developed and validated the 12-item Shoulder Problems Assessment Scale (SPAS), an activity-based PROM using a hierarchical stepwise yes/no format, with field testing on 415 patients at 12 outpatient PT centers.
items.curatedReason: 肩部疼痛功能评估又添新工具。SPAS 量表采用分层是非格式，旨在简化解读。考虑在你的诊所工作流中试用，尤其是对那些现有 PROMs 填写困难的患者。
items.titleZh: 肩部问题评估量表 (SPAS) 的开发与心理测量学验证
items.summaryZh: 研究人员开发并验证了 12 项肩部问题评估量表 (SPAS)，该量表是一种基于活动的患者报告结局量表，采用分层是非格式，并在 12 个门诊物理治疗中心的 415 名患者中进行了现场测试。
items.curatedReasonEn: A new tool for shoulder pain assessment, the SPAS scale, uses a hierarchical yes/no format to simplify interpretation. Consider piloting it in your clinical workflow, especially for patients who struggle with existing PROMs.
items.limitation: 研究未明确报告患者访谈和专家评审的具体方法学细节，可能影响量表开发的透明度。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly report detailed methodological specifics for patient interviews and expert reviews, which may affect the transparency of scale development.

items.title: Arm exercise training in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
items.summary: An umbrella review synthesizing six databases up to May 2026 concluded that arm exercise training is a valuable component of pulmonary rehabilitation for COPD patients, addressing extrapulmonary features and skeletal muscle dysfunction.
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述强化了手臂运动训练在 COPD 肺康复中的证据基础。你可以更有信心地将手臂训练纳入你的 COPD 患者康复计划，以改善其肺外表现，作为整体肺康复的重要组成部分。
items.titleZh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者手臂运动训练：系统综述和荟萃分析的伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项汇总了截至 2026 年 5 月的六个数据库的伞形综述得出结论，手臂运动训练是 COPD 患者肺康复的重要组成部分，有助于改善肺外表现和骨骼肌功能障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review strengthens the evidence for arm exercise training in COPD pulmonary rehabilitation. You can more confidently integrate arm training into your COPD patient rehab plans to improve extrapulmonary manifestations as a vital component of overall pulmonary rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 伞形综述的局限性在于其结果受限于纳入的系统综述和荟萃分析的质量和异质性。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of an umbrella review is that its results are constrained by the quality and heterogeneity of the included systematic reviews and meta-analyses.

items.title: More Than Just Arm Movement: Finger-Worn Accelerometers Provide a Valid and Sensitive Alternative to Wrist-Worn Accelerometers for Measuring Real-World Upper-Limb Performance in Stroke Survivors
items.summary: Finger-worn accelerometers provided a valid and sensitive alternative to wrist-worn accelerometers for measuring real-world upper-limb performance in 20 stroke survivors with mild-to-moderate impairment, offering a more comprehensive assessment.
items.curatedReason: 指戴式加速计作为腕戴式设备的替代方案，在卒中患者上肢功能评估中展现出有效性和敏感性。这提示你，未来在远程监测或日常活动评估中，指戴设备可能提供更精细的运动数据，从而优化康复策略。
items.titleZh: 不止是手臂运动：指戴式加速计在测量卒中幸存者真实世界中上肢表现方面提供了一种有效且敏感的腕戴式加速计替代方案
items.summaryZh: 指戴式加速计在测量 20 名轻中度上肢损伤卒中幸存者的真实世界中上肢表现方面，提供了一种有效且敏感的腕戴式加速计替代方案，提供了更全面的评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: Finger-worn accelerometers show validity and sensitivity as an alternative to wrist-worn devices for assessing upper-limb function in stroke survivors. This suggests that in future remote monitoring or daily activity assessments, finger-worn devices might provide finer motor data, optimizing rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 研究设计为横断面观察性，不能建立因果关系，且样本量较小（20名卒中幸存者），限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional observational design cannot establish causality, and the small sample size (20 stroke survivors) limits the generalizability of the results.

items.title: When algorithms don't care: physiotherapy and the post-professional turn.
items.summary: This paper argues that physiotherapy, like other health professions, is entering a post-professional era driven by the commodification of health, unbundling of professional claims, and digitally mediated technological disruption, potentially marginalizing practitioners.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文章触及了物理治疗专业在算法和数字化时代可能面临的“后专业化”挑战。它提醒你，在技术重塑医疗服务模式的背景下，需要重新思考 PT 的核心价值和执业模式，以应对潜在的边缘化风险。
items.titleZh: 当算法无情：物理治疗与后专业化转向
items.summaryZh: 本文认为，物理治疗与更广泛的医疗专业一样，正进入一个“后专业化”时代，其驱动力是健康商品化、专业主张的解绑以及数字化技术颠覆，这可能导致从业者被边缘化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article addresses the potential 'post-professional' challenges facing physical therapy in the age of algorithms and digitalization. It reminds you to reconsider PT's core values and practice models in the context of technology reshaping healthcare delivery, to mitigate the risk of marginalization.

items.title: Therapeutic Exercise Protocol During Hospitalization in Pediatric Oncohematological Patients: Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial with 30 pediatric oncohematological patients (8-17 years) found that a therapeutic exercise program during hospitalization positively impacted muscle strength and fatigue compared to minimal physiotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，住院期间早期治疗性运动对肿瘤患儿的肌肉力量和疲劳有积极影响。这支持你在儿童肿瘤患者的住院康复中，更积极地推行运动干预，可能有助于改善生活质量和功能。
items.titleZh: 住院血液肿瘤患儿的治疗性运动方案：随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 30 名 8-17 岁住院血液肿瘤患儿的随机临床试验发现，住院期间的治疗性运动方案对肌肉力量和疲劳有积极影响，优于最小活动物理治疗对照组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that early therapeutic exercise during hospitalization has positive effects on muscle strength and fatigue in pediatric oncology patients. This supports a more proactive approach to exercise interventions in the inpatient rehabilitation of pediatric oncology patients, potentially improving quality of life and function.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（30 名参与者），可能限制结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size (30 participants) may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Neuralgic Amyotrophy Following Rotator Cuff Repair: A Patient's Experience.
items.summary: This case report describes a 64-year-old male who developed severe neuralgic amyotrophy 8 days after rotator cuff repair, achieving substantial functional recovery over one year with prolonged, progressive physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 肩袖修复术后出现臂丛神经炎相对罕见但会严重影响功能。本病例报告提示即便出现此类并发症，长期强化物理治疗仍能带来显著的功能恢复。遇到类似情况，维持患者治疗依从性至关重要。
items.titleZh: 肩袖修复术后臂丛神经炎：一例患者的经验
items.summaryZh: 本病例报告描述了一名 64 岁男性在肩袖修复术后 8 天出现严重臂丛神经炎，通过长期渐进式物理治疗，在一年内实现了显著的功能恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: Neuralgic amyotrophy after rotator cuff repair is rare but can severely impact function. This case report suggests that even with such complications, prolonged intensive physical therapy can lead to significant functional recovery. Maintaining patient adherence is crucial in similar situations.
items.limitation: 作为单例病例报告，本研究的发现不具有普遍性，无法推断至其他患者群体。
items.limitationEn: As a single case report, the findings of this study are not generalizable and cannot be extrapolated to other patient populations.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy following posterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a case report.
items.summary: A 51-year-old woman undergoing integrated rehabilitation, including aquatic therapy, after PCL reconstruction, showed improvements in knee pain, range of motion, and functional activities, highlighting aquatic therapy's potential for early recovery.
items.curatedReason: PCL 重建术后康复具有挑战性，水疗可能提供一种低负荷的早期康复环境。虽然本案例展示了水疗的积极效果，但请记住这仅是孤立的病例报告，在常规引入前仍需更多高级别证据。
items.titleZh: 后交叉韧带重建术后结合水疗的综合康复：一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一名 51 岁女性在后交叉韧带重建术后接受了包括水疗在内的综合康复，膝关节疼痛、活动范围和功能活动均有所改善，凸显了水疗在早期康复中的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: PCL reconstruction rehabilitation is challenging, and aquatic therapy might offer a low-load environment for early recovery. While this case shows positive effects, remember it's an isolated case report; more high-level evidence is needed before routine implementation.
items.limitation: 本研究为单例病例报告，其结果不具备普遍性，不能作为临床决策的强证据。
items.limitationEn: This study is a single case report, and its findings are not generalizable and cannot serve as strong evidence for clinical decision-making.

items.title: Comparative effectiveness of exercise-based prehabilitation before total knee arthroplasty: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis compared the effectiveness of various exercise-based prehabilitation modalities before total knee arthroplasty, aiming to clarify optimal approaches.
items.curatedReason: 这份高分的系统综述及网络Meta分析是TKA术前康复方案设计的决定性证据：告诉你在多种运动干预中，哪种效果更优。以后给TKA患者做术前康复，就按这个来。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术前运动康复的比较效果：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和网络Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和网络Meta分析比较了全膝关节置换术前不同运动康复模式的有效性，旨在明确最佳干预方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-scoring systematic review and network meta-analysis is definitive evidence for designing TKA prehabilitation protocols, showing which exercise interventions are more effective. Follow this guidance for TKA prehab from now on.
items.limitation: 研究未明确报告具体运动模式下的效果量，且缺乏对术后长期结局的分析。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly report effect sizes for specific exercise modalities and lacked analysis of long-term postoperative outcomes.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Differences in the Thoracolumbar Fascia Between Low Back Pain Patients and Healthy Individuals: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis confirmed differences in thoracolumbar fascia characteristics between low back pain patients and healthy individuals, highlighting its potential role in LBP.
items.curatedReason: 该Meta分析确认了腰骶筋膜（TLF）在腰痛患者和健康个体之间存在结构和功能差异，支持TLF在腰痛中的力学和伤害感受作用。这强化了您在评估和治疗腰痛时，应将TLF作为重要关注点，整合筋膜手法和运动控制训练。
items.titleZh: 腰痛患者与健康个体腰骶筋膜的差异：一项系统综述与Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述与Meta分析证实，腰痛患者与健康个体在腰骶筋膜特征上存在差异，提示其在腰痛中的潜在作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis confirms structural and functional differences in the thoracolumbar fascia (TLF) between low back pain patients and healthy individuals, supporting TLF's mechanical and nociceptive role in LBP. This reinforces that you should consider TLF a key focus in assessing and treating LBP, integrating fascial manipulation and motor control training.
items.limitation: 不同研究中TLF特征的测量方法和报告结果存在异质性。
items.limitationEn: There was heterogeneity in the measurement methods and reported outcomes of TLF characteristics across different studies.

items.title: Effects of tDCS combined with unstable resistance training on knee muscle strength and neuromuscular control in community-dwelling older adults: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) combined with unstable resistance training improved knee muscle strength and neuromuscular control in community-dwelling older adults.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT发现经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）联合不稳定抗阻训练能提升老年人的膝关节肌力和神经肌肉控制。这提示您在老年康复中可考虑将tDCS作为辅助手段，与功能性训练结合，以期获得更好的膝关节功能改善。
items.titleZh: tDCS联合不稳定抗阻训练对社区老年人膝关节肌力和神经肌肉控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）联合不稳定抗阻训练能提升社区老年人的膝关节肌力和神经肌肉控制。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that tDCS combined with unstable resistance training improved knee muscle strength and neuromuscular control in older adults. This suggests you could consider tDCS as an adjunct to functional training in geriatric rehabilitation for potentially better knee function outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究仅关注社区老年人，结果外推到其他老年人群需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study focused solely on community-dwelling older adults, so results should be cautiously generalized to other older populations.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Vancomycin-Soaked Quadriceps Grafts Linked to Early Resorption in ACLR: study
items.summary: A study suggests that vancomycin-soaked quadriceps grafts are linked to early resorption following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究指出万古霉素浸泡的股四头肌移植物与ACL重建术后早期吸收有关。这直接影响您在评估和管理ACL重建术后患者时，对移植物稳定性和并发症的预期和监测，尤其是在有药物浸泡史的病例中。
items.titleZh: 研究：万古霉素浸泡的股四头肌移植物与ACL重建术后早期吸收相关
items.summaryZh: 一项研究提示，万古霉素浸泡的股四头肌移植物与前交叉韧带重建术后的早期吸收有关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates a link between vancomycin-soaked quadriceps grafts and early resorption after ACLR. This directly impacts your expectations and monitoring of graft stability and complications when evaluating and managing post-ACLR patients, especially those with a history of soaked grafts.
items.limitation: 新闻报道未提供原始研究的具体细节（如样本量、研究设计），因此结论需谨慎对待。
items.limitationEn: The news report does not provide specific details of the original study (e.g., sample size, study design), so conclusions should be treated with caution.

items.title: Repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across different movement patterns in amateur soccer players
items.summary: A study investigated repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across various movement patterns in amateur soccer players.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，业余足球运动员在不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应有差异。你在设计训练方案时，要考虑这些模式差异，但本研究无法告诉你如何优化。
items.titleZh: 业余足球运动员在不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应
items.summaryZh: 一项研究考察了业余足球运动员在不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests amateur soccer players show varied repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across different movement patterns. When designing training, consider these pattern differences, but this study doesn't tell you how to optimize.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于业余足球运动员，结果在专业运动员中可能存在差异。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to amateur soccer players; results may differ for professional athletes.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Federated learning for privacy-preserving collaborative health risk classification using wearable sensor data: validation study with elite football training load monitoring
items.summary: A validation study demonstrated federated learning's ability to classify health risks using wearable sensor data from elite football players while preserving privacy.
items.curatedReason: 这项验证研究展示了联邦学习在保护精英足球运动员可穿戴传感器数据隐私的同时，进行健康风险分类的潜力。这有助于您在应用技术监控高水平运动员训练负荷时，平衡数据利用与隐私保护的需求。
items.titleZh: 联邦学习在精英足球训练负荷监测中应用于隐私保护协作健康风险分类的验证研究
items.summaryZh: 一项验证研究表明，联邦学习能够在使用可穿戴传感器数据监测精英足球运动员训练负荷时，在保护隐私的前提下进行健康风险分类。
items.curatedReasonEn: This validation study demonstrates the potential of federated learning for privacy-preserving health risk classification using wearable sensor data in elite football players. This helps you balance data utilization with privacy protection when applying technology to monitor training loads in high-level athletes.
items.limitation: 研究的重点在于技术验证，并未直接评估其对临床决策或康复干预的实际影响。
items.limitationEn: The study focuses on technical validation and does not directly assess its practical impact on clinical decision-making or rehabilitation interventions.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Visually identified breakpoints in muscle oxygen saturation are not equivalent to ventilatory thresholds in national-level triathletes
items.summary: A study found that visually identified breakpoints in muscle oxygen saturation (SmO2) are not equivalent to ventilatory thresholds in national-level triathletes.
items.curatedReason: 研究明确指出，别再用视觉判定的SmO2断点代替通气阈值来评估国家级铁人三项运动员的运动强度了，它们并不等同。评估时，继续使用多种生理指标进行交叉验证。
items.titleZh: 国家级铁人三项运动员肌肉氧饱和度视觉断点与通气阈值不等同
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现，国家级铁人三项运动员的肌肉氧饱和度（SmO2）视觉断点与通气阈值不等同。
items.curatedReasonEn: The study clearly states: stop using visually identified SmO2 breakpoints as a proxy for ventilatory thresholds to assess exercise intensity in national-level triathletes; they are not equivalent. Continue cross-referencing with multiple physiological indicators during assessment.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于国家级铁人三项运动员，结果在其他人群或运动类型中可能不同。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to national-level triathletes, and results may differ in other populations or sport types.

items.title: Trump Administration Announces $144 million to Improve Mental Health, Substance Abuse, Emergency and Maternal Care and Expand the Healthcare Workforce in Alabama
items.summary: The Trump Administration announced a $144 million allocation to enhance mental health, substance abuse, emergency, and maternal care, and expand the healthcare workforce in Alabama.
items.curatedReason: 美国特朗普政府宣布拨款1.44亿美元用于改善阿拉巴马州的心理健康、药物滥用、急诊和孕产妇护理，并扩大医疗保健劳动力。这笔资金可能影响当地PT的转诊网络和与其他医疗专业人员的协作。
items.titleZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款1.44亿美元改善阿拉巴马州医疗健康服务并扩大医护队伍
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款1.44亿美元，用于改善阿拉巴马州的心理健康、药物滥用、急诊和孕产妇护理，并扩大医疗保健劳动力。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Trump Administration announced $144 million to improve mental health, substance abuse, emergency, and maternal care, and expand the healthcare workforce in Alabama. This funding could impact local PT referral networks and collaboration with other healthcare professionals.

items.title: Does surgical approach or preoperative deformity better predict outcomes in thoracolumbar fractures? A comparative study of minimally invasive versus open techniques
items.summary: A comparative study investigated whether surgical approach or preoperative deformity better predicts outcomes in thoracolumbar fractures treated with minimally invasive versus open techniques.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，胸腰椎骨折患者的术前畸形程度可能比手术方式更能预测预后。作为物理治疗师，这让你在患者术后康复时，多关注他们术前畸形的程度，而不是手术切口大小。
items.titleZh: 手术入路或术前畸形，哪个能更好地预测胸腰椎骨折的结局？微创与开放技术的比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项比较研究探讨了在胸腰椎骨折治疗中，手术入路或术前畸形哪个能更好地预测微创与开放技术治疗后的结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests preoperative deformity may be a better predictor of outcomes than surgical approach for thoracolumbar fractures. As a physical therapist, this means focusing more on the degree of preoperative deformity in your patients' post-op rehab, rather than incision size.
items.limitation: 研究的结局指标主要集中在外科预后，对物理治疗相关的功能性恢复结局未详细阐述。
items.limitationEn: The study's outcome measures primarily focused on surgical prognosis, with less detailed elaboration on functional recovery outcomes relevant to physical therapy.

items.title: Beyond treatment: how care process factors shape physical therapist management of low back pain.
items.summary: This commentary examines how various care process factors, such as timing of care, point of entry, care pathway design, and insurance models, significantly influence patient outcomes in low back pain management, independent of specific treatment interventions.
items.curatedReason: 理解影响腰痛物理治疗效果的因素，不仅要看治疗本身，更要关注患者接受护理的流程设计、时间节点和支付模式。这些“护理过程因素”对患者结局影响重大，是你改善执业模式时需要考虑的关键维度。
items.titleZh: 超越治疗：护理过程因素如何塑造物理治疗师对腰痛的管理
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评探讨了护理过程因素（如护理时机、起始提供者、护理路径设计和保险模式）如何在不依赖具体治疗干预的情况下，显著影响腰痛管理中的患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: Beyond just the treatment, factors like care process design, timing, and payment models significantly shape outcomes in low back pain physical therapy. These 'care process factors' are crucial for you to consider when optimizing your practice model and patient pathways.

items.title: Intensive, Multi-Technology Rehabilitation Programme for Chronic Stroke Survivors: Outcomes of a Phase I Single-Arm Repeated-Measures Study.
items.summary: A Phase I single-arm study found that an 8-week, group-based, multi-technology rehabilitation program led to observed improvements in motor recovery for chronic stroke survivors with persistent motor impairment.
items.curatedReason: 对慢性卒中患者来说，这类为期 8 周、结合多技术和小组形式的康复计划可能有助于运动功能恢复。尽管只是初步的 I 期观察研究，但它提示我们，在卒中长期康复中，整合多种技术和集体治疗模式值得探索。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中幸存者的密集多技术康复项目：I 期单臂重复测量研究结果
items.summaryZh: 一项 I 期单臂研究显示，为期 8 周的、基于小组的、结合多种技术的康复项目，使持续存在运动障碍的慢性卒中幸存者的运动功能得到改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic stroke survivors, an 8-week, group-based, multi-technology rehabilitation program appears promising for motor recovery. While this is only a preliminary Phase I observational study, it suggests that integrating diverse technologies and a group setting merits further investigation in long-term stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 单臂研究设计限制了其因果推断能力，且样本量未明确。
items.limitationEn: The single-arm study design limits its causal inference capabilities, and the sample size was not explicitly stated.

items.title: A qualitative inquiry into the environmental barriers and facilitators to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guideline adherence among Canadian physiotherapists.
items.summary: A qualitative inquiry explored environmental barriers and facilitators influencing Canadian physiotherapists' adherence to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guidelines, identifying key factors across public and private sectors using the Theoretical Domains Framework and Ecological Systems Theory.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了加拿大物理治疗师在非特异性腰痛临床实践指南依从性方面面临的环境障碍和促进因素。了解这些因素有助于优化指南实施策略，提升你在腰痛管理中的临床依从性。
items.titleZh: 加拿大物理治疗师非特异性腰痛临床实践指南依从性的环境障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了影响加拿大物理治疗师依从非特异性腰痛临床实践指南的环境障碍和促进因素，通过理论领域框架和生态系统理论识别了公共和私营部门的关键因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals environmental barriers and facilitators to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guideline adherence among Canadian physiotherapists. Understanding these factors can help optimize guideline implementation strategies and improve your clinical adherence in LBP management.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，其发现的普遍性和外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study, and the generalizability and external validity of its findings are limited.
